macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street futures edge higher as oil steadies and U.S.-Iran tensions persist
items.summary: U.S. stock index futures rose modestly as global markets and oil prices stabilized after fresh U.S. strikes on Iran revived geopolitical anxiety. Reuters said investors were weighing the risk that the conflict could disrupt efforts to end the four-month conflict.

items.title: Fed official John Williams says he does not expect a sustained surge in energy prices
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said he was not expecting the renewed Middle East conflict to cause a lasting spike in energy prices over the rest of the year. The comment helped frame recent market moves around geopolitical risk rather than a broader inflation shock.

items.title: European Central Bank minutes show inflation seen staying above target into next year
items.summary: ECB policymakers were shown projections last month indicating inflation would remain above target into next year despite nearly three rate hikes. The minutes underscore a still-cautious central bank stance on easing policy further.

items.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures tick up as tech shares stabilize
items.summary: MarketScreener reported that U.S. index futures firmed as technology stocks steadied. The move suggests investors were digesting recent volatility in growth shares rather than abandoning the sector.

items.title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since 2022
items.summary: Reuters reported that China’s producer price inflation surged for a fourth straight month in June to its highest level since July 2022, while consumer prices also rose. The data point to persistent cost pressure for manufacturers.

items.title: German business sentiment improves as recovery remains slow
items.summary: Ifo reported that German business sentiment rose in June, but the institute also said the country’s economic recovery will take time. Separate data showed German exports unexpectedly rose in May, supporting a slightly better near-term outlook for Europe’s largest economy.

items.title: Australian shares wobble as Fed caution offsets oil-price optimism
items.summary: MarketScreener said Australian equities were mixed as caution around the Fed tempered the boost from oil-price moves. The report highlights how central-bank signals remain a key driver for global risk assets.

items.title: Samsung Electronics leads notable stock moves in 24-hour market activity
items.summary: Among the most mentioned names over the past 24 hours, Samsung Electronics stood out with an 8.22% gain. Other active names included Zalando, Bridgepoint Group, London Stock Exchange Group, and Banco Santander.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI broadly releases GPT-5.6 and launches ChatGPT Work
items.summary: OpenAI has broadly released GPT-5.6 and introduced ChatGPT Work, an AI agent that can gather context across apps and files to create documents on macOS and Windows. The rollout also includes multiple model variants with different pricing tiers.

items.title: OpenAI merges Codex and ChatGPT desktop apps
items.summary: OpenAI is combining its Codex and ChatGPT desktop apps into a new ChatGPT desktop app for Mac and Windows. The new app lets users switch between Codex, Chat, and Work.

items.title: Anthropic updates Claude Fable 5 billing and access
items.summary: Anthropic is adding usage-based billing for Fable 5 and plans to return the model to Claude subscription plans when capacity allows. Separate reporting says the company may temporarily remove access to the top model from subscriptions.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.1 to developers
items.summary: Meta has released Muse Spark 1.1, describing it as a more advanced coding model and a step-change from the first generation. The model is available to US developers through a public API preview.

items.title: OpenAI fully rolls out GPT-Live to paid users
items.summary: OpenAI has fully rolled out its GPT-Live feature to users on Go, Plus, and Pro tiers and is working on making it available to free users. The feature expansion signals continued productization of real-time AI interaction.

items.title: Ant Group’s Lingbo Technology releases two open-source models
items.summary: Ant Group’s Lingbo Technology has launched LingBot-World 2.0 for real-time interactive world generation and LingBot-Video, an open-source foundation model for embodied AI video generation. The releases add to the rapid growth of open-source multimodal models.

items.title: Mistral releases OCR 4 for document intelligence
items.summary: Mistral has reportedly released OCR 4, a self-hosted document-intelligence model supporting 170 languages with bounding boxes, block classification, and inline confidence scores. The update highlights continued competition in enterprise document AI.

items.title: Alibaba unveils Qwen Robot Suite for embodied AI
items.summary: Alibaba has introduced the Qwen Robot Suite, including RobotNav, RobotWorld, and RobotManip models aimed at embodied AI and robotics. The release positions Alibaba as a stronger competitor in physical AI.

items.title: NVIDIA introduces DFlash speculative decoding and BioNeMo Agent Toolkit
items.summary: NVIDIA has announced DFlash, a speculative decoding method claiming much faster Blackwell inference, along with a new BioNeMo Agent Toolkit for AI-driven science. The announcements reinforce NVIDIA’s push into both infrastructure and applied AI.

items.title: OpenAI ships GPT-5.5-Cyber to vetted security firms
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly released GPT-5.5-Cyber to selected security firms and says it achieved strong results on CyberGym. The company is also expanding defender programs focused on patching and security testing.
